messages:
marta_csm: Quick heads-up — CedarBridge Health. Renewal ~45d out and we just flagged a 65% drop in MAUs this month. New ML lead (Priya) left last week, procurement pinged us about on-prem options and said they're talking to AtlasAI. https://console.redwood.infra/customers/cedarbridge/overview

alex_solutions: Ugh. Did they call out any specific gaps with our product, or is this a stakeholder change + procurement exploration?

marta_csm: Mostly stakeholder churn + they mentioned 'lower inference costs' from AtlasAI. They also said onboarding for the data connectors wasn't finished — only 40% of seats completed the SSO step.

devon_ae: @marta_csm can you share the last engagement notes? I want to see who the champion was and any outstanding enablement tasks. If procurement is already talking to AtlasAI, we should surface our Dedicated pricing and quantization cost-savings comparison ASAP.

marta_csm: Pasted notes from last touch: "Champion: Priya (ML lead) — demo + PoC successful; blocked by onboarding infra and SSO. Requested Dedicated trial for throughput tests." Action items I left: schedule new ML lead intro + handoff docs.

sam_eng: Quick check I ran on usage: ```
SELECT date, active_prompts
FROM usage_events
WHERE customer = 'cedarbridge'
ORDER BY date DESC
LIMIT 30;
```
Shows a steep fall starting 2026-03-05 after the last week of the PoC. Could be automation or prefix caching removed during PoC teardown.

liz_support: I can pick up the connector/SSO runbook and run a 30-min pairing session with their infra lead. I've got availability Tue/Wed next week.

devon_ae: Good — also propose we offer a 30-day Dedicated extension with a cost-comparison summary and a quick ROI slide for the execs. I'll draft the pricing note. @alex_solutions can you build the AtlasAI comparison (latency/cost/features) and add a brief playbook for the new ML lead?

alex_solutions: On it. I'll pull latency percentiles from our perf dashboard and approximate AtlasAI based on public docs. Will add a short checklist: SSO, connectors, perf smoke test, eval dataset.

marta_csm: Plan: 1) Liz to run SSO/connectors pairing (schedule today) 2) Alex & Devon to produce pricing + ROI + competitive note by EOD Thu 3) I set up a 30-min intro with new ML contact and an exec QBR for week of 3/22 4) Capture feedback: run quick survey after pairing — ask "primary blocker" and "expected cost target".

devon_ae: I'll also prep a short template for the exec QBR (1 slide: value, 1 slide: cost comparison, 1 slide: next steps). Want to own the QBR? I can lead it with @marta_csm co-presenting.

marta_csm: Yes please lead. I'll own stakeholder coordination and provide the product/usage narrative.

ops_bot: Reminder: Renewal in 45 days for CedarBridge Health. SLA: standard. Auto-create follow-up task if no response in 72h.

marta_csm: Noted. If we don't get buy-in after pairing, escalate to renewal engineering for a custom perf run. Also capturing this thread as the handoff doc.

liz_support: Scheduling now — sending calendar options.

alex_solutions: Draft competitive note posted to the shared folder: https://drive.redwood/cs/cedarbridge/comp_notes. Will tag you all when ready.

marta_csm: Thanks everyone. Main risk: stakeholder churn + incomplete onboarding. Mitigations: immediate pairing, pricing/ROI, exec QBR. Will update thread after the pairing session. :thumbsup:
